name: External v3 (PlantSeg tomato disease, duplicate-screened)
status: Locked and committed before any model was evaluated on this set.
image_decode: PlantSeg parquet image bytes -> PIL -> EXIF transpose -> RGB (as Notebook 11)
label_set: Early Blight, Late Blight, Bacterial Spot, Septoria Leaf Spot (canonical IDs 1-4). Healthy is absent; models keep their five-way heads.
primary_metric: Five-way accuracy over all included images (a Healthy prediction counts as an error).
secondary_metrics: Macro-F1 over the four present disease labels, computed from five-way predictions
Disease-restricted accuracy: argmax over the four disease logits only (isolates disease discrimination from the Healthy bias)
Healthy prediction rate: share of diseased images predicted Healthy
Per-class recall; Wilson 95% intervals for accuracies

primary_comparisons.test: two-sided sign-flip permutation test on per-image mean correctness across the three seeds, 10,000 permutations, seed 0

intervals: Paired image-level bootstrap 95% percentile interval for each primary accuracy difference (b - a), 10,000 resamples, seed 0
sensitivity_analyses: Exclude images whose shorter side is below 224 pixels
one_shot: The evaluation writes to a new directory and refuses to overwrite. Any re-run must be reported with its reason.
scope: PlantSeg images are web-collected with expert-reviewed masks. Results describe this screened public set; they are not a deployment estimate and do not cover Healthy specificity.
